label: Guest first
meaning: Made a guest's visit easier, warmer or better than they expected.

label: Craft
meaning: Quality work on the cut and the finish, every guest, every time.

label: Team player
meaning: Jumped in to help a teammate or another salon without being asked.

label: Shows up
meaning: Reliable, on time and ready, especially when it was not easy.

label: Grows others
meaning: Taught, coached or encouraged someone to get better.

label: Owns it
meaning: Saw a problem, took responsibility and fixed it.
